title: Leap years
description: is_leap_year(year) should return True for leap years. A year is a leap year if it is divisible by 4, except years divisible by 100, which are leap years only if they are also divisible by 400.
expected_behaviour: is_leap_year(2024) and is_leap_year(2000) return True; is_leap_year(1900) returns False.

bug.summary: The condition leaves out the divisible-by-400 rule, so years like 2000 are wrongly rejected.

tests.description: another year divisible by 100 but not 400

hints.1: Check every part of the rule in the description against your code, especially the exception to the exception. What should happen for the year 2000?
hints.2: Look at the condition in the return statement on line {line}. Which part of the description's rule does it never mention?
hints.3: The condition rejects every year divisible by 100, including years like 2000 that are also divisible by 400. It needs an extra case so that those years still count as leap years.
